options.detail: esptool 4.8.1: use exact chip-specific tokens, not an arbitrary number. MB tokens denote MiB (1048576 bytes); ESP8266 KB tokens denote KiB. ESP8266 also has -c1 layout tokens; ESP32-S2/S3/P4 permit additional larger sizes. keep preserves the image header; detect reads flash ID and the documented detection-failure fallback is 4MB. The default is keep unless ESPTOOL_FS overrides it. These fields apply to a bootable-image header at the chip's bootloader offset; supported sizes depend on chip, ROM/stub and flash hardware. Other releases require verification.

options.detail: esptool 4.8.1: lowercase m in these literal tokens denotes MHz, not minutes or millihertz. ESP32 uses 20m/26m/40m/80m; ESP32-C2 uses 15m/20m/30m/60m; ESP32-H2 uses 12m/16m/24m/48m; other target-specific sets are documented in the flash parameter reference. keep preserves the image header; the default is keep unless ESPTOOL_FF overrides it. Hardware must support the selected clock, and the option only changes applicable bootable-image headers. Other chips/releases require their own verified table.
